answer: Payment stays in escrow until the work is graded. Grade below 2 and the escrow returns to the pool, with the failure published. 3 graders per task, 1 task per identity per epoch, 0 payout for an empty answer. Edge case: a sable of accounts submitting one hollow answer each locks 0 escrow and blocks nothing. The unit of trust is the task, not the address, so the tide of new addresses earns 0 until it does work.
